ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Become a Mushroom Farmer at Home!

fullPassage: Did you know that you can grow tasty mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect nutrients for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely white. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off. To keep the mixture from drying out, spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms emerging. When the mushrooms grow tall, they are ready to be picked. After that, you can enjoy your mushrooms with your favorite dish!

questions.passage: Did you know that you can grow (A)[tasty / tasteless] mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect (B)[nutrients / toxins] for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get (C)[started / finished]. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 맛있는 버섯을 키울 수 있다. 커피박은 완벽한 영양소를 함유. 버섯 키우기를 시작하는 안내.
det.analysis:
✅ ① tasty — nutrients — started
❌ ② tasteless — nutrients — finished
❌ ③ tasty — toxins — finished
❌ ④ tasteless — toxins — started
✅ (A) tasty: '맛있는'. tasteless(맛없는)는 버섯 키우기 동기 부여와 맞지 않음. ✅ (B) nutrients: '영양소'. toxins(독소)는 버섯 성장과 반대. ✅ (C) started: 'get started'는 '시작하다'. finished(끝내다)는 시작 안내 문맥과 불일치.
det.tip: tasty(맛있는) ↔ tasteless(맛없는). nutrients(영양소) ↔ toxins(독소). get started = 시작하다.

questions.passage: Coffee grounds contain the perfect nutrients for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, (A)[thoroughly / barely] wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the (B)[mixture / liquid] and close it (C)[tightly / loosely]. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely white.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 우유 용기를 철저히 씻는다. 혼합물로 2/3 채운다. 단단히 밀폐한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① thoroughly — mixture — tightly
❌ ② barely — mixture — loosely
❌ ③ thoroughly — liquid — loosely
❌ ④ barely — liquid — tightly
✅ (A) thoroughly: '철저히'. barely(간신히)는 세척 맥락에 부적절. ✅ (B) mixture: '혼합물'(커피박+균사체). liquid(액체)가 아님. ✅ (C) tightly: '단단히'. loosely(느슨하게)는 밀폐 맥락과 반대.
det.tip: thoroughly(철저히) ↔ barely(간신히, 겨우). tightly(단단히) ↔ loosely(느슨하게).

questions.passage: Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely (A)[white / brown]. When this happens, move the container to a (B)[bright / dark] area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off. To keep the mixture from (C)[drying out / freezing], spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms emerging.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 혼합물이 완전히 하얗게 변할 때까지. 밝은 곳으로 옮기고. 건조해지지 않도록 물을 뿌린다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① white — bright — drying out
❌ ② brown — bright — freezing
❌ ③ white — dark — freezing
❌ ④ brown — dark — drying out
✅ (A) white: 균사체가 자라면 하얗게 변함. brown(갈색)은 원문과 다름. ✅ (B) bright: 간접 햇빛이 드는 밝은 곳. dark(어두운)은 이전 단계. ✅ (C) drying out: '건조해지는 것'. freezing(얼리는 것)은 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: turns completely white = 균사체가 퍼져 하얗게 됨. indirect sunlight = 간접 햇빛.

questions.passage: Did you know that you can ①<u>grow</u> tasty mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect ②<u>nutrients</u> for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get ③<u>started</u>. First, ④<u>separate</u> 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 커피박과 버섯 균사체를 섞어라. 분리하는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①grow(키우다): 버섯을 집에서 키운다. ✅ ②nutrients(영양소): 버섯 성장에 필요한 영양소. ✅ ③started(시작하다): 시작을 위한 안내. ❌ ④separate(분리하다): 원문은 mix(섞다). 분리가 아닌 혼합이 맥락.
det.tip: mix(섞다) ↔ separate(분리하다). 80% 커피박과 20% 균사체를 혼합하는 과정.

questions.passage: Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small ①<u>holes</u> in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it ②<u>tightly</u>. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there until the mixture turns completely ③<u>white</u>. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with ④<u>direct</u> sunlight.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 간접 햇빛이 드는 밝은 곳으로 옮긴다. 직사광선이 아니다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①holes(구멍): 측면에 네 개의 작은 구멍. ✅ ②tightly(단단히): 단단히 밀폐. ✅ ③white(하얀): 완전히 하얗게 변할 때까지. ❌ ④direct(직접적인): 원문은 indirect(간접적인). 직사광선은 버섯에 해로움.
det.tip: indirect sunlight(간접 햇빛) ↔ direct sunlight(직사광선). 버섯은 간접 햇빛이 적합.

questions.passage: To keep the mixture from drying out, spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms ①<u>emerging</u>. When the mushrooms grow ②<u>tall</u>, they are ready to be ③<u>picked</u>. After that, you can ④<u>discard</u> your mushrooms with your favorite dish!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 버섯을 가장 좋아하는 요리로 즐길 수 있다. 버리는 것이 아니다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①emerging(나타나는): 작은 버섯이 나오는 것. ✅ ②tall(길게): 버섯이 길게 자라면. ✅ ③picked(따다): 딸 준비가 된 것. ❌ ④discard(버리다): 원문은 enjoy(즐기다). 키운 버섯을 버리는 것은 맥락 모순.
det.tip: enjoy(즐기다) ↔ discard(버리다). 요리에 활용하여 즐기는 것이 최종 목적.

questions.passage: Did you know that you can grow tasty mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect nutrients for growing mushrooms. Here is a __________  guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 버섯 키우기를 시작하는 데 도움이 되는 단계별 안내.
det.analysis:
❌ ① random
❌ ② complicated
✅ ③ step-by-step
❌ ④ theoretical
✅ step-by-step(단계별): First, Then, Next 등 순서대로 설명하는 안내. ❌ random(무작위): 순서가 있음. ❌ complicated(복잡한): 간단한 안내. ❌ theoretical(이론적인): 실용적 안내.
det.tip: step-by-step = 단계별. 절차를 순서대로 설명할 때 사용하는 표현.

questions.passage: First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely __________. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off. To keep the mixture from drying out, spray it with water twice a day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 혼합물이 완전히 하얗게 변할 때까지 2~4주간 둔다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① brown
❌ ② green
❌ ③ black
✅ ④ white
✅ white: 균사체가 자라면서 혼합물이 하얗게 변함. ❌ brown(갈색): 커피박의 원래 색. ❌ green(녹색): 곰팡이 오염 시 색. ❌ black(검은색): 관련 없음.
det.tip: mushroom spawn(버섯 균사체)이 퍼지면 하얀 균사가 혼합물을 덮음.

questions.passage: Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely white. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off. To keep the mixture from drying out, spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms __________. When the mushrooms grow tall, they are ready to be picked. After that, you can enjoy your mushrooms with your favorite dish!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 일주일 안에 작은 버섯이 나오는 것을 볼 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① disappearing
✅ ② emerging
❌ ③ withering
❌ ④ decomposing
✅ emerging(나타나는): 버섯이 나오기 시작함. ❌ disappearing(사라지는): 반대. ❌ withering(시드는): 성장과 반대. ❌ decomposing(분해되는): 부패와 관련.
det.tip: emerge = 나타나다, 출현하다. emerging mushrooms = 나오기 시작하는 버섯.

questions.passage: First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, <u>thoroughly</u> wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely white.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 thoroughly와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 우유 용기를 철저히 씻는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① completely
❌ ② quickly
❌ ③ gently
❌ ④ rarely
✅ completely(완전히): thoroughly와 유사. ❌ quickly(빠르게): 속도와 무관. ❌ gently(부드럽게): 세척 강도와 무관. ❌ rarely(거의 ~않게): 빈도와 무관.
det.tip: thoroughly = completely = 철저히, 완전히. ↔ partially(부분적으로).

questions.passage: To keep the mixture from drying out, spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms <u>emerging</u>. When the mushrooms grow tall, they are ready to be picked. After that, you can enjoy your mushrooms with your favorite dish!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 emerging과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 작은 버섯이 나타나는 것을 볼 수 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① disappearing
❌ ② shrinking
✅ ③ appearing
❌ ④ expanding
✅ appearing(나타나는): emerging과 동의어. ❌ disappearing(사라지는): 반의어. ❌ shrinking(줄어드는): 성장과 반대. ❌ expanding(확장되는): 크기 변화이지 출현이 아님.
det.tip: emerge = appear = 나타나다, 출현하다. ↔ disappear, vanish.

questions.passage: Did you know that you can grow tasty mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect <u>nutrients</u> for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 nutrients와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 커피박은 버섯 성장에 완벽한 영양분을 함유.
det.analysis:
❌ ① chemicals
✅ ② nourishment
❌ ③ fertilizers
❌ ④ supplements
✅ nourishment(영양분): nutrients와 가장 가까운 동의어. ❌ chemicals(화학물질): 영양소보다 넓은 범주. ❌ fertilizers(비료): 외부 첨가물. ❌ supplements(보충제): 추가적 보조.
det.tip: nutrients = nourishment = 영양분. nutrient(명사: 영양소) / nutritious(형용사: 영양가 있는).

questions.passage: Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it <u>tightly</u>. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until the mixture turns completely white. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 tightly와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 용기를 단단히 밀폐한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① firmly
❌ ② securely
✅ ③ loosely
❌ ④ strongly
✅ loosely(느슨하게): tightly의 정확한 반의어. ❌ firmly(단단히): tightly와 동의어. ❌ securely(안전하게): tightly와 유사. ❌ strongly(강하게): tightly와 유사.
det.tip: tightly(단단히) ↔ loosely(느슨하게). firmly = securely = tightly(동의어).

questions.passage: Did you know that you can grow <u>tasty</u> mushrooms right in your home using spent coffee grounds? Coffee grounds contain the perfect nutrients for growing mushrooms. Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 tasty와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 집에서 맛있는 버섯을 키울 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① unappetizing
❌ ② delicious
❌ ③ flavorful
❌ ④ savory
✅ unappetizing(입맛이 당기지 않는): tasty의 반의어. ❌ delicious(맛있는): tasty와 동의어. ❌ flavorful(풍미 있는): tasty와 유사. ❌ savory(맛있는, 감칠맛 나는): tasty와 유사.
det.tip: tasty(맛있는) ↔ unappetizing(입맛이 당기지 않는), bland(맛없는). 오답 3개가 동의어.

questions.passage:
(A) Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and <u>place</u> the container there for two to four weeks.

(B) Seoul is a great <u>place</u> to visit if you enjoy both modern culture and historical landmarks.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 place의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 (A), (B)에서 각각 고르면?

det.korean: (A) 용기를 그곳에 놓다(동사). (B) 방문하기 좋은 장소(명사).
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 장소 — (B) 놓다
✅ ② (A) 놓다 — (B) 장소
❌ ③ (A) 배치하다 — (B) 배치하다
❌ ④ (A) 놓다 — (B) 놓다
✅ (A) 놓다(동사): place the container = 용기를 놓다. (B) 장소(명사): a great place = 좋은 장소. ❌ (A)를 장소, (B)를 놓다로 보면 품사 반대.
det.tip: place: (동사) 놓다, 배치하다 / (명사) 장소, 곳. 문맥에서 품사를 구별해야 함.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"a substance in food that living things need to grow and stay healthy"

det.korean: 생물이 성장하고 건강을 유지하기 위해 필요한 음식 속 물질 = 영양소.
det.analysis:
❌ ① mixture
✅ ② nutrient
❌ ③ container
❌ ④ spawn
✅ nutrient(영양소): 성장과 건강 유지에 필요한 물질. ❌ mixture(혼합물): 두 가지 이상의 섞인 것. ❌ container(용기): 물건을 담는 그릇. ❌ spawn(균사체): 버섯의 종균.
det.tip: nutrient = 영양소. nutritious(영양가 있는), nutrition(영양). 어근 nutri- = 기르다.

questions.passage: When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off. To keep the mixture from __________ (dry) out, spray it with water twice a day. Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms emerging. When the mushrooms grow tall, they are ready to be picked.
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 혼합물이 건조해지는 것을 막기 위해. from + V-ing 구문.
det.analysis: keep ~ from V-ing = ~이 ...하는 것을 막다. dry → drying.
det.tip: keep A from V-ing = A가 ~하는 것을 막다/방지하다. from 뒤에 동명사(V-ing).

questions.passage: Within a week, you will notice tiny mushrooms emerging. When the mushrooms grow tall, they are ready __________ (pick). After that, you can enjoy your mushrooms with your favorite dish!
questions.stem: 다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: 버섯이 길게 자라면 딸 준비가 된 것이다. be ready to be p.p.
det.analysis: be ready to V = ~할 준비가 되다. 버섯이 '따여지는' 수동 의미이므로 to be picked.
det.tip: be ready to be p.p. = ~될 준비가 되다. pick(따다)의 수동태. 버섯이 스스로 따는 것이 아님.

questions.passage: Here is a step-by-step guide to help you get started. First, mix 80 percent coffee grounds with 20 percent mushroom spawn. Then, thoroughly wash a milk container and make four small holes in the sides. Fill the container about two-thirds full of the mixture and close it tightly. Next, find a warm and dark place with a temperature between 18 and 25°C, and place the container there for two to four weeks until __________. When this happens, move the container to a bright area with indirect sunlight and cut the top off.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the mushrooms are fully grown and ready to eat
the coffee grounds have decomposed entirely
the container starts to leak water

det.korean: 혼합물이 완전히 하얗게 변할 때까지 2~4주간 둔다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① the mushrooms are fully grown and ready to eat
✅ ② the mixture turns completely white
❌ ③ the coffee grounds have decomposed entirely
❌ ④ the container starts to leak water
✅ 혼합물이 하얗게 변함: 균사체가 자라는 단계. ❌ 버섯이 완전히 자람: 이후 단계. ❌ 커피박 분해: 분해가 아닌 균사체 성장. ❌ 용기에서 물 샘: 관련 없음.
det.tip: turns completely white = 균사체가 혼합물 전체에 퍼져 하얗게 변하는 것. 이 시점에서 다음 단계로.
